## Description

HIP/HIU integration: Scan & Share at reception, consent requests approved on the patient's phone, linked records (FHIR bundles) shown with source for the consented period; care-context linking of Medvya visits.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** ABDM sandbox certification passed.
- [ ] **AC2.** Linked records display with ABDM provenance and consent period, never merged into verified data without clinician acceptance.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
